title.narrative: Integrated multi-sector assistance to support return process in Sedal Woreda, Kamashi Zone, Benishangul Gumuz Region.

description.narrative: ltpgtThe project aims to support inter-communal conflict affected returnees in Kamashi zone, Benishangul Gumuz Region, living with limited access to basic services provided from the humanitarian partners and governmental structures. The multi sectoral and integrated response in alignment with the 1st standard allocation of EHF covers the sectors of Health, Nutrition, Agriculture, WaSH, ESNFI, Education, Protection and MPC to address needs of returnees and host communities in Sedal woreda.ltbrgtThe project has been identified and designed jointly by MCMDO, COOPI and AEID. MCMDO, lead applicant, will coordinate, facilitate and liaise with the donor for the smooth implementation of the whole program as well as of the activities related to Health, Nutrition, Agriculture and WASH. COOPI will be in charge of implementing NFI and Emergency Shelter and MPC furthermore, it will assure capacity building initiatives on humanitarian standards AEID will cover the sectors of Education and Protection. The role and responsibility of each partner will be clearly defined through a formal partnership agreement that will bring greater impact on the wellbeing of target beneficiaries. The integrated intervention will address MHNT and CMAM approach by improving access to essential primary health care and nutrition services support the emergency campaign and communicable disease outbreak prevention and controls MHPSS services for most vulnerable returnee communities. WASH response will cover the subsectors of water supply, sanitation and hygiene promotion, targeting also education and Health facilities. The Consortium will ensure the distribution of standard WASH-NFI including WTC and hygiene awareness creation, water quality monitoring, the rehabilitation of water scheme and latrines, including desluging or decommissioning as appropriate. ltbrgtUnder ESNFI, will support access to HLP (housing land and property) counselling in order to enable and ensure durable solutions. Furthermore, the project foresees the distribution of 1,100 Emergency Shelter Repair Kit V4 and technical support on shelter repair. The education intervention will improve those emergency-affected school-age children into getting access to equitable, safe, inclusive, and quality education by providing scholastic materials, and rehabilitation of schools. The Protection Responses will includes risk mitigation, and provision of GBV services, strengthening essential services for survivors of GBV, including case management and psychosocial support services. Whereas The agriculture sector major activities includes Provision of agricultural inputs, livestock veterinary drugs and multi-purpose cash for the targeted groups. The education intervention will Improve those emergency-affected school-age children into getting access to equitable, safe, inclusive, and quality education by providing scholastic materials, and rehabilitation of schools.nbspMoreover the MPC, aimed at protecting dignity of returnees, is meant to address the need of the returnee’s population allowing them to prioritize their critical unmet need and complementing the other sectoral intervention. Furthermore, the consortium will assure strong coordination with other humanitarian partners in the Cluster System. ltbrgtThe project will target 49,468 (20,804 Women, 8,838 Girls, 11,209 Men and 8618 Boys) beneficiaries for the period of 12 months with a total budget of USD 2,300,000.00.ltbrgtlt/pgt
